## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] No unapproved visible presentation changes.
- [ ] Authorization enforced independently of model output and UI state.
- [ ] Data-backed visuals include provenance and freshness.
- [ ] Failures fail closed; no stale data is represented as current.
- [ ] Accessibility and error/offline states considered.
- [ ] Documentation updated.
